requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The product must present only one unique product name/reference to customers on 123.hp.com to avoid confusion and user error.
requirements.Additional_Comments: Is there a reason to have 3 names for the same reference? HP OJP 9010 All-in-one Printer series, HP OJP 9010e All-in-One Printer series, HP OJP 9010 All-in-One Printer. Having too many names isn't efficient and can induce user errors.
requirements.Threshold_Accept: Two names/reference are proposed; currently 4 references for Office Jet Pro 9010.
requirements.Goal_Design_Target: Only one name/reference is proposed to customer.
requirements.Remarks: Quality team is following-up with Tais Bellini. 20210702 (Chris/Jess) Not possible to change in 123.hp.com as it reference to Product Master List where is common shared with PC group. It is only currently possible to do at support.hp.com. Proposed to Drop.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must successfully operate and meet intervention specifications for all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media under various climatic conditions for the Manhattan platform.
requirements.Additional_Comments: Printer to meet intervention spec for the different media and climatic conditions for Manhattan platform.
requirements.Goal_Design_Target: Pass intervention rate and NO PQ issue
requirements.Remarks: 20220920(Sau Pin): LP2 Life test are meeting Intervention rate(Qual) 20220316 (Sau Pin): I assume baseline is same as Manhattan. Status as "Yellow" as need to review intervention performance. Accept threshold. EM media as Eval media.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must operate reliably and without damage to components (such as the input tray sensor flag) when placed on uneven surfaces including sofas, tablecloths, and carpets.
requirements.Additional_Comments: As the complaint on Vasari, input tray sensor flag broken when printer is placed on uneven surface, this issue should be fixed in new product.
requirements.Remarks: 20220315(Sau Pin): Marconi Base LP1 test with no issue reported. Marconi Hi and PDL SKUs testing on-going. HDRV response: Have conducted sanity check with Manhattan Base & Hi, Malbec Hi and Agave. Only Malbec Hi had issue with input tray flag broken. Need TME input on field data for 3M. Aiqiang: Manhattan field data shows tray "fang" broken. ME will look at solutions to solve fang broken issue such as to strengthen the fang.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The requirement requests evaluation of functional failure when the printer is tilted 20 degrees left or right during printing. (Note: This is relevant for CISS products, not Marconi.)
requirements.Reason_for_Ambiguity: Requirement is not actionable for Marconi products as per remarks; unclear scope for current batch.
requirements.Additional_Comments: To assess whether there is any functional failure if customer tilt the printer during printing. (Sayan tilt left and right each at 20 degree while printing )
requirements.Remarks: tilt 20 degree is for CISS product as acknowledged by Michelle. Shin to check if want to evaluate on Manhattan Plus with XXL ink cartridges. Close for Marconi.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must operate and print without print quality issues when placed on a trolley.
requirements.Additional_Comments: To check if there is PQ issue when printer print on trolley.
requirements.Remarks: (Sau Pin): Marconi Base LP1 test with no issue reported. Marconi Hi and PDL SKUs testing on-going. Interesting to find out the test result. HDRV response: Have conducted sanity check with Manhattan Base & Hi, Malbec Hi and Agave. No issue found. Agree to put it as evaluation. To be consistent with standard UBT requirement.20220315
